item.title: Rallying Cry – November 9, 2026
item.description: From Senegalese surfers reclaiming the waves to police in India lighting up Diwali for drivers, and women leading the charge in Pakistan’s football and Karnataka’s dairy industry, today’s good news spans joy, progress, and unity across the globe.
